description: Implement render_to_png and render_to_pdf in renderer.py using Playwright to produce valid PNG/PDF output from the HTML template. Add playwright dependency to pyproject.toml. Include browser lifecycle management with lazy initialization and proper cleanup.
steps: Add 'playwright>=1.48.0' to the dependencies list in packages/agent/pyproject.toml

In packages/agent/src/print_generator/renderer.py, implement render_to_png using Playwright's async API: launch Chromium with headless mode, set viewport to A4 at 96dpi (794x1123), set content with wait_until='networkidle' (to load Google Fonts), take a full-page screenshot, close browser, return PNG bytes

In packages/agent/src/print_generator/renderer.py, implement render_to_pdf using Playwright's async API: launch Chromium, set content with wait_until='networkidle', generate PDF with format='A4', close browser, return PDF bytes

Add browser lifecycle management: use a module-level approach to launch browser once and reuse across calls for performance in the AgentCore container. Include proper error handling and a helper function _get_browser() that handles lazy initialization and ensures Chromium is installed (calling playwright install chromium if needed via subprocess).
Ensure the HTML content is loaded with sufficient wait time for Google Fonts to download (use wait_until='networkidle' or explicit wait for fonts)
Keep the existing function signatures intact: async def render_to_png(html: str) -> bytes and async def render_to_pdf(html: str) -> bytes
Add proper error handling: if Playwright/Chromium is not available, raise a clear RuntimeError with instructions
acceptance_criteria: render_to_png returns bytes that start with the PNG magic bytes (\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n)
render_to_pdf returns bytes that start with the PDF magic bytes (%PDF-)
Function signatures remain async def render_to_png(html: str) -> bytes and async def render_to_pdf(html: str) -> bytes
verification: cd packages/agent && uv run playwright install chromium --with-deps

cd packages/agent && uv run python -c "import asyncio; from src.print_generator.renderer import render_html, render_to_png; html = render_html([{'number': 1, 'text': '1+1='}], 'テスト'); png = asyncio.run(render_to_png(html)); assert png[:8] == b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n', f'Not valid PNG: {png[:8]}'; print(f'PNG OK: {len(png)} bytes')"
cd packages/agent && uv run ruff check src/
findings: 1. pyproject.toml had pre-existing bug: build-backend was 'hatchling.backends' (invalid), fixed to 'hatchling.build'. 2. Added [tool.hatch.build.targets.wheel] packages=['src'] to support the src/ layout. 3. Playwright Chromium installed without --with-deps since apt-get is not available in sandbox (not Ubuntu). 4. The 'Event loop is closed' warning from asyncio.run() in one-off scripts is expected and harmless in production. 5. Pre-existing ruff lint errors (17) exist in other src/ files but renderer.py passes cleanly. 6. uv.lock file generated and committed.
